nav.home.context: Main navigation: the website home page.

nav.games.context: Main navigation: create and browse games.

nav.live.context: Join the Live Quiz game with a teacher-provided code; not website registration. Keep the game name Live Quiz.

nav.pricing.context: Navigation to subscription plans and prices.

nav.info.context: Navigation to usage information and frequently asked questions.

nav.login.context: Open the sign-in or registration dialog.

appearance.darkGame.context: Switch the game area to a dark appearance.

appearance.brightGame.context: Switch the game area to a light appearance, not a clever game.

settings.title.context: Compact profile section for language and light/dark appearance preferences.

settings.language.context: Label for the English/Spanish preference buttons.

game.check.context: Check the answer and turn/reveal the question card; never controlar.

game.checkAnswer.context: Reveal or verify a quiz answer.

game.question.context: Interface label only; never translate the actual question.

game.answer.context: Interface label only; never translate the actual answer.

game.quit.context: Leave the current game; confirm losing progress.

game.end.context: Finish the game session and show results.

game.team.context: Default team name only. Keep custom teacher/player names unchanged. Preserve {number}.

game.start.context: Start playing with the selected settings.

game.nextQuestion.context: Advance to the next quiz question.

game.correct.context: Answer feedback, not the verb to correct written text.

game.scoreRound.context: Teacher awards points after a round.

game.applyScores.context: Save the points awarded in the scoring stage.

common.back.context: Go back to the previous screen.

common.select.context: Select an item, not copy it.

nav.signIn.context: Compact header button opening the login dialog.

nav.openMenu.context: Accessible name of the mobile navigation button.

nav.closeMenu.context: Accessible name of the mobile navigation button when open.
